title: Vernissage
subtitle: Multiplayer 3D art exhibitions
description: Curate your own exhibition from 8,263 public-domain works from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, then walk through it in 3D with whoever opens the link: a Go API and WebSocket hub on Oracle Cloud behind a Next.js front end.

title: Vantage · Robot Arm Suite
subtitle: 6-DOF arm simulation & control
description: One safety-gated motion pipeline for a 6-DOF industrial arm, driven six ways: joystick, keyboard, Whisper voice, autonomous PIN entry, an LLM agent and webcam hand gestures.

title: Logarithm Warehouse
subtitle: Resilient microservices platform
description: A fragile e-commerce monolith rebuilt as Order and Inventory services with a database each, behind an Nginx load balancer. A Redis counter keeps the chaos tests deterministic across three inventory replicas, watched live in Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Ryōiki Tenkai · 領域展開
subtitle: Interactive Domain Expansions
description: Jujutsu Kaisen's Domain Expansions as a 2.5D portal depth tunnel, a domain clash simulator and a code-split three.js realm, with manga impact frames and a soundtrack synthesized in the Web Audio API.

title: ebru
subtitle: A shared marbling tray
description: Turkish paper marbling that anyone can work in at once: the same Rust marbling maths runs on the server and, compiled to WebAssembly, in the browser, bit for bit, with prints saved to a shared gallery.

title: kirie
subtitle: A pop-up book of the sky
description: A paper pop-up book of the sky over 36 places, lit by the live weather there and the real sun and moon, with readers seeing each other's paper cranes in real time.

title: Asterism
subtitle: AR stargazing app
description: Hold your phone to the sky and it names what you see: stars, planets and the ISS, drawn on the UI thread with Skia, plus a forecast of whether tonight is worth going out. The link is its web version.

title: lumen
subtitle: A search engine from scratch
description: A crawler, inverted index, BM25 ranking and snippets written with nothing but Go's standard library, live here searching the 400 pages of the Go blog it crawled.

title: gedis
subtitle: Redis, from scratch
description: A Redis-compatible in-memory store that speaks RESP, so the official redis-cli talks to it, with replication, AOF persistence and eviction. A public, fenced-off instance takes connections on port 6380.

title: ShopCircuit
subtitle: E-commerce storefront
description: A full storefront with cart, checkout, wishlist and order tracking, plus an admin panel for catalogue and content, on React and Firebase with a Node/Express payment backend.
